description: POST /v2/account/keys answers 422 `SSH Key is already in use on your account` when the key material is already registered on the team — a distinct, recoverable condition (look the existing key up by fingerprint) that shares its status with unparseable key material (`Fingerprint could not be generated, please make sure your key is valid`). Type the duplicate as SshKeyAlreadyRegistered via a message matcher; the malformed case stays UnprocessableEntity.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The public key is already registered on this team (422 `SSH Key is already in use on your account`).
